_what: Proposed .claude/settings.local.json for the unattended daily radar (com.nakshiq.loop-radar). Claude is hard-blocked from editing permission settings itself — install.sh applies this after YOUR review.
_scope: Writes confined to .loop/, data/research/, .scrapes/. No DB grants, no deploy grants, no settings grants. The loop-guard PreToolUse hook stays active on every Bash call (blocks push-to-main, DROP/DELETE, rm -rf, etc.).
